infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Leanient reads selected Apple Health data like weight, workouts, steps, active energy, and body fat to personalize your weekly verdict.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Leanient saves selected logs to Apple Health when you choose.

plugins.cameraPermission: Leanient uses your camera to scan meals and estimate protein.

plugins.cameraPermission: Leanient uses your camera so you can take a profile picture.
